item.title: Reckoning with Multiple Myeloma
item.description: In June of 2026, my father was diagnosed with multiple myeloma. The diagnosis sent me looking for a way to understand what was happening to him from the ground up. This is that notebook - me trying to understand the important aspects of this cancer: the basics of cell biology, what turns a healthy cell cancerous, how myeloma is diagnosed, how it is treated, how we know those treatments work through clinical trials, where care is heading, and how treatment differs in the US and India.
